name: PatientsByGender
title: Patients by gender
description: Counts patients by gender, taking the display text from the administrative-gender value set, which the server does not hold and so expands via the configured terminology server. Author: John Grimes.

relatedArtifact.label: gender_codes
relatedArtifact.display: Administrative gender value set, exposed as a relation

extension.valueString:
SELECT gender_codes.display AS gender, COUNT(*) AS patients
FROM patient_demographics
JOIN gender_codes
  ON gender_codes.code = patient_demographics.gender
GROUP BY gender_codes.display
ORDER BY gender_codes.display
